title: Surface inventory create errors and block invalid submissions

requirements.summary: Improve inventory item creation UX by validating inputs client-side, showing clear English backend error reasons, and ensuring the inventory list refreshes after create.
acceptanceCriteria: If product creation fails, the toast shows an English error message that includes the backend error reason (not a generic failure only).
The create button is disabled (or submission is blocked) when required numeric inputs cannot be parsed into valid numbers.
After a successful create, the inventory list refreshes and the new product appears without a manual reload.

file_operations.description: Add client-side validation for required text fields (ensure description/category are non-empty after trimming) and numeric fields (ensure all required numeric inputs parse to finite numbers; ensure stock fields parse to valid integers for BigInt). Block submission and/or disable the submit button when invalid. Update error toasts to be in English and include the extracted backend reason via extractErrorMessage (e.g., "Failed to create product: <reason>"). Keep success flow closing the dialog and relying on the inventory query invalidation to refresh the list.

Ensure the inventory create mutation continues to invalidate the inventory query on success so InventoryPage refreshes automatically, and avoid swallowing errors so InventoryItemForm can surface the backend-provided reason.
